=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of a picnic photograph posted 1 July 2018. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group. Red 46 Bari, Italy. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk.
